detail.longDescription: So, my org makes a book. Its current distribution format is # PDF and the generator system is a dumpster fire. It needs to be replaced, so we can use pictures and equations and CSS and stuff. Here's the tricky part: it needs to be distributed as a single file, readily viewable offline on Windows PCs by non-tech people, like with a PDF. The usual “self-contained package full of # HTML pages” format is # EPUB , but Windows doesn't come with an EPUB viewer. What do? # webdev
